<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914059_theRebbe_310" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914059_theRebbe_310__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains how the two interpretations of "Shuva Yisrael ad" correspond to two levels of light revealed through teshuvah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, we can explain the connection between the two interpretations of "Shuva Yisrael ad" —</t>
    <t s="1">(whether this "ad" means "up to and including,"</t>
    <t s="2">or whether this "ad" means "up to but not including") —</t>
    <t s="3">with the two interpretations of "Shuva Yisrael ad Hashem Elokecha":</t>
    <t s="4">[the interpretation] that Hashem will be your G-d, your strength and vitality, and [the interpretation] that Hashem will be only a level of Elokim and contraction relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem.</t>
    <t s="5">For the interpretation of "Shuva Yisrael ad" that it is "ad" meaning "up to and including,"</t>
    <t s="6">the light to which negative knowledge applies,</t>
    <t s="7">which generally is the Or HaSovev (Encompassing Light),</t>
    <t s="8">corresponds to the interpretation that "Hashem will be your G-d, your strength and vitality,"</t>
    <t s="9">[meaning] the light that is revealed through teshuvah is the Or HaSovev</t>
    <t s="10">(Hashem).</t>
    <t s="11">And the interpretation of "Shuva Yisrael ad" that it is "ad" meaning "up to but not including,"</t>
    <t s="12">the light to which even negative knowledge does not apply,</t>
    <t s="13">corresponds to the interpretation that "Hashem will be only a level of Elokim and contraction relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem,"</t>
    <t s="14">[meaning] the light that is revealed through teshuvah is the light that is above even the Or HaSovev.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the addition of "Hashem Elokecha" after "ad" points to a level higher than even "ad lo biChlal," as even the name Hashem (vocalized as Elokim) is merely a name relative to the Essence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And on a deeper level, it can be said</t>
    <t s="2">that the reason the verse adds "Hashem Elokecha" after already saying "Shuva Yisrael ad,"</t>
    <t s="3">is that the concept of "Hashem Elokecha" —</t>
    <t s="4">that Hashem is only a level of Elokim and contraction relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem —</t>
    <t s="5">is higher even than "ad lo biChlal."</t>
    <t s="6">And this will be understood based on what was explained above15</t>
    <t s="7">that in the word "Hashem" in the verse "Shuva Yisrael ad Hashem Elokecha," there is also included "Hashem" vocalized as "Elokim,"</t>
    <t s="8">which is an exceedingly lofty level,</t>
    <t s="9">as explained in Likkutei Torah16</t>
    <t s="10">(on the verse17</t>
    <t s="11">"Ken Adonai Hashem Yatzmiach Tzedakah...")</t>
    <t s="12">the greatness of the elevation of the two names Adonai and Hashem</t>
    <t s="13">(vocalized as Elokim).</t>
    <t s="14">And nevertheless it is written "ad Hashem Elokecha,"</t>
    <t s="15">that even this Hashem is only a level of Elokim and contraction relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem,</t>
    <t s="16">because even Hashem</t>
    <t s="17">(vocalized as Elokim)</t>
    <t s="18">is only a name.</t>
    <t s="19">And as explained in Likkutei Torah18</t>
    <t s="20">regarding the two levels of the shofar that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="21">"And Adonai Hashem will blow the shofar... and He will blow a great shofar,"19</t>
    <t s="22">[explaining] that the shofar of "And Adonai Hashem will blow the shofar,"</t>
    <t s="23">since even Adonai Hashem</t>
    <t s="24">(vocalized as Elokim)</t>
    <t s="25">are only names,</t>
    <t s="26">is a plain shofar,</t>
    <t s="27">but regarding the great shofar it is written "He will blow a great shofar,"</t>
    <t s="28">"He will blow" is stated plainly, and it does not say who is the blower,</t>
    <t s="29">because this blowing is an efflux and revelation from the aspect of the Hidden of All Hidden.</t>
    <t s="30">And it is explained in Likkutei Torah there,</t>
    <t s="31">that correspondingly is the difference between Rosh HaShanah and Yom HaKippurim,</t>
    <t s="32">that the shofar of Rosh HaShanah is like "And Adonai Hashem will blow the shofar,"</t>
    <t s="33">and on Yom HaKippurim it is written20</t>
    <t s="34">"Before Hashem you shall be purified,"</t>
    <t s="35">above Hashem,21</t>
    <t s="36">and moreover,22</t>
    <t s="37">"For on this day He will atone for you,"20</t>
    <t s="38">"He will atone" is stated plainly, and it does not say who is the atoner,21</t>
    <t s="39">like "He will blow a great shofar,"</t>
    <t s="40">"He will blow" is stated plainly.</t>
    <t s="41">And this is what is said in the haftarah of Shabbos Shuvah,</t>
    <t s="42">"Shuva Yisrael ad Hashem Elokecha,"</t>
    <t s="43">that this "Hashem" also refers to Hashem vocalized as Elokim,</t>
    <t s="44">because on Shabbos Shuvah there already exists a taste of the elevation of Yom HaKippurim,23</t>
    <t s="45">and relative to this elevation, even Hashem vocalized as Elokim is only a level of Elokim and contraction.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that after "ad" (including "ad lo biChlal"), the addition of "Hashem Elokecha" points to the essential connection of the soul with Atzmus, where defect is inherently inapplicable.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, we can explain that after the verse says "Shuva Yisrael ad,"</t>
    <t s="1">in which is included even "ad lo biChlal,"</t>
    <t s="2">it adds "Hashem Elokecha,"</t>
    <t s="3">because even the concept of "ad lo biChlal,"</t>
    <t s="4">although even negative knowledge does not apply to it</t>
    <t s="5">(as above, section 3),</t>
    <t s="6">nevertheless, from the fact that it is necessary to negate and say "ad lo biChlal,"</t>
    <t s="7">it is understood24</t>
    <t s="8">that it has some connection.</t>
    <t s="9">And this is like the concept of the Baal HaRatzon (Master of Will) from whom forgiveness is drawn</t>
    <t s="10">(as explained above25),</t>
    <t s="11">which generally is the concept of the names Adonai and Hashem vocalized as Elokim, through which all defects are filled,26</t>
    <t s="12">for although the fact that forgiveness is drawn from Him for that which they did contrary to the will is because He is not compelled in the will,27</t>
    <t s="13">nevertheless, the will has a connection to it</t>
    <t s="14">(as is proven from the fact that He is called "Baal HaRatzon"),</t>
    <t s="15">and therefore the forgiveness must be for that which they did contrary to the will.28</t>
    <t s="16">But regarding the Essence of the Ein Sof, which is above even the Baal HaRatzon,</t>
    <t s="17">defect is inherently inapplicable.</t>
    <t s="18">And as explained elsewhere29</t>
    <t s="19">regarding the concept that "the essence of the day atones,"30</t>
    <t s="20">that the atonement that comes from the essence of the day is</t>
    <t s="21">(not in a manner of action,</t>
    <t s="22">but rather)</t>
    <t s="23">that on this day the connection of the essence of the soul with Atzmus is revealed</t>
    <t s="24">(which is above even the Baal HaRatzon),</t>
    <t s="25">[such that] relative to this level, defect is inherently inapplicable.</t>
    <t s="26">And this is that after it says "Shuva Yisrael ad," it adds "Hashem Elokecha,"</t>
    <t s="27">for since Shabbos Shuvah is a preparation for Yom HaKippurim,</t>
    <t s="28">therefore the teshuvah of Shabbos Shuvah must be not only "ad,"</t>
    <t s="29">[even] "ad lo biChlal,"</t>
    <t s="30">through which all defects will be nullified,</t>
    <t s="31">but rather it is also necessary to arouse and reveal the point of Yiddishkeit,</t>
    <t s="32">the connection of the essence of the soul with Atzmus</t>
    <t s="33">(which is above even the Baal HaRatzon),</t>
    <t s="34">relative to which even Hashem vocalized as Elokim is only a level of Elokim and contraction,</t>
    <t s="35">and through this it is revealed that the undesirable matters are only in externality,</t>
    <t s="36">but in internality31</t>
    <t s="37">(from the perspective of the connection of Yisrael and the Holy One, Blessed be He),</t>
    <t s="38">there were inherently no undesirable things.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
